text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(It happened when I was little. I got
injured while running with my
friends.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(I was put on doctor's orders, totally
banned from moving. All I could
do was
sleep for aaages. But during one of those
rests...)

text_block_list.name: Young Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Where... am I? I'm underwater... Did I go
swimming in a river... and get
carried away
by the current?

text_block_list.name: Young Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What if I can't get out? What if I drown at
the bottom of the river?!
Rickey. Listen to me.

text_block_list.name: Young Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who's there?

Do not fear misfortune. Learn the way of
fortune.

Understand? Learn how to bring about
fortune.

text_block_list.name: Young Rickey
text_block_list.text: Is that you... Dragon God?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Yes, that was the day I opened my eyes
to feng shui, and I've been
hooked ever
since. And now...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Fool! Proposal dismissed.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Please reconsider, Air Groove! Don't you
want every student to feel
stronger and
happier? Then...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Putting feng shui in the curriculum is a
no-brainer! Rickey! ☆ Lucky! ☆
Everyone's
happy!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Not happening. What we need is study
and training, not superstition.
Now get
out!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait! Why won't she understand?
Feng shui isn't a superstition.
There's
nothing to be so distrustful about!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm passing through the corridor, I
stumble right into a bizarre
scene—a
student was kicked out of the student
office for pushing
feng shui too hard. She
turns to me...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you there. You must be a trainer,
right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to do some feng shui with
me? You're interested,
right? Right?
Right?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm sure you could do with some more
good luck! ☆ Now, come
with me. I'll teach
you everything—starting from the
basics! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly find myself being dragged
outside...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You know how people say they're lucky or
unlucky? And when
something goes
wrong, they blame it on bad luck?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well, the truth is, they don't have bad
luck. They just don't
understand auspicious
directions and how the five elements
compete,
or how to use those things to
their advantage. For example...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
When you redecorate your room, doesn't
it feel like the air gets
fresher as well?
That's because of the way you changed
your furniture.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's because you've both reduced the
overhead pressure you feel
while sleeping
and blocked the channels where wealth
could escape!
You just didn't know it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So? Aren't you impressed? Now that
you've heard my explanation, I
bet you
can't wait to know more!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: What? Even after I explained it so well?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Was it too complicated? If only there
was a quick and easy way
to explain the
appeal of feng shui...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There was nothing wrong with her
explanation, but it just didn't sound
like
the kind of thing I should jump into
believing right away.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait! Don't go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's best not to get too involved with her.
As I turn to leave...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow's tryouts!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Come watch me at tomorrow's tryouts! I'll
show you the power of feng
shui there!
Once you see it, you'll believe it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey waves her hands vigorously
at me as I walk away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Aha, I knew you'd come watch! You acted
all disinterested, but deep
down, you were
curious about feng shui, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The tryouts are important races. Whether
or not Copano Rickey was
running, there
are other students who I would've come to
watch.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
My race is coming up soon. In the
meantime, why don't you get a nice,
hot
cup of oolong tea to soothe the soul? ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You're going to need it! Once you see me
running with the power of
feng shui, your
heart might start pounding out of your
chest! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Putting aside whether feng shui is real or
not, it seems to be Copano
Rickey's
driving force.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And seeing how she's this pumped up, I
wouldn't be surprised if she
puts on a
great showing. It's nice to see a rookie with
spirit.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hold on. The power spot at this
training track is...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere feels a bit off. I wonder...
has the flow of qi
changed?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What was it that moved, the visible
landform? Or the invisible
compass?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In any case, something's about to happen
in the next race! I have a
bad feeling
about it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not just in my head. The girls about
to race look uneasy too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What's causing this? Where is it stemming
from?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her face suddenly turns glum. She looks so
serious that it's hard to
brush it off as
superstition.
